scope: Current destination facts for three catalog records; source-catalog reconciliation

records.text: A nationally representative study follows students who were ninth-graders in fall 2009 into postsecondary education. Its observational data support analysis of educational pathways; causal effects require a separate credible study design.
records.before: A nationally representative study follows students who were ninth-graders in fall 2009 into postsecondary education. Its observational data support analysis of educational pathways; causal effects require a separate credible study design.

records.text:
## Catalog metadata

- **Steward:** National Center for Education Statistics
- **Access:** Public-use custom extracts through NCES DataLab; restricted-use files require a license
- **Access URL:** https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/hsls09/hsls09_data.asp
- **Unit:** Longitudinal student record with linked parent, teacher, counselor, school, transcript, and postsecondary records
- **Coverage:** 2009 ninth-grade cohort through 2021 postsecondary administrative records
- **Geography:** nation, selected states
- **Record identifiers:** Student record, wave, and school record where permitted; apply survey weights for analysis.
- **Measures:** course taking, CTE participation, math assessment, college expectations, postsecondary enrollment and completion
- **Uses:** postsecondary pathway context, course-taking context, CTE and college-readiness context

National cohort context; school and student identifiers are suppressed in public-use files, so causal initiative evaluation requires a separate study design.

[Official resource](https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/hsls09/)

records.text: A nationally representative cross-sectional survey describes crime and safety in U.S. public schools. It provides school-safety context rather than longitudinal estimates of program effects.
records.before: A nationally representative cross-sectional survey describes crime and safety in U.S. public schools. It provides school-safety context rather than longitudinal estimates of program effects.

records.text:
## Catalog metadata

- **Steward:** National Center for Education Statistics
- **Access:** Public-use data files and documentation; restricted-use files require a license
- **Access URL:** https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/ssocs/data_products.asp
- **Unit:** Sampled public school, cross-sectional
- **Coverage:** 1999-2000 onward; most recent public-use cycle 2021-22
- **Geography:** nation
- **Record identifiers:** Survey cycle and school record; apply survey weights for analysis.
- **Measures:** incidents, discipline, safety policies, security, mental-health and restorative supports
- **Uses:** school climate context, discipline context, safety implementation context

A nationally representative school survey, not a longitudinal impact evaluation or a school-level program-effect file.

[Official resource](https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/ssocs/)

records.text: An Institute of Education Sciences resource reviews education research and summarizes findings about interventions and practices. Read its assessments alongside the underlying primary studies.
records.before: An Institute of Education Sciences resource reviews education research and summarizes findings about interventions and practices. Read its assessments alongside the underlying primary studies.

records.text:
## Catalog metadata

- **Steward:** Institute of Education Sciences
- **Access:** Public evidence reviews and study-level exports
- **Access URL:** https://ies.ed.gov/ncee/wwc/
- **Unit:** Reviewed intervention or study
- **Coverage:** Continuously updated repository
- **Geography:** study-dependent
- **Record identifiers:** Intervention name, study citation, and WWC review identifier.
- **Measures:** study quality, outcome domain, effect direction, evidence tier
- **Uses:** study-quality normalization, evidence discovery

A review repository, not an outcome dataset; preserve the primary study alongside any WWC assessment.

[Official resource](https://ies.ed.gov/ncee/wwc/)
